verdict.rationale: Retell exposes full API coverage via official Node/Python SDKs, a CLI, and a hosted MCP server that dynamically exposes the entire API (list/get/invoke endpoint tools), confirmed by keyless runtime probes actually reaching the CLI and MCP handshake — meaning nearly anything doable in the dashboard (agents, phone numbers, knowledge bases, function calling, voice cloning, analytics) is API/CLI/MCP accessible. missing for 10: no public OpenAPI spec was found (404s across candidate paths), and no independent hands-on confirmation that every single UI feature (e.g., analytics dashboards, AI QA config) has a 1:1 API equivalent.
